name: Maishima Yuuri
source:
With a beautiful, voluptuous body, Yuri is always turning heads. She is a kind and beautiful woman who cares about everyone, and in return, she is loved by all who know her. At home, she lives with her mother and younger brother. She dreams of becoming a doctor, just like her mother, to help as many people as possible. Due to a certain incident, Yuri is given the power to transform into Angel Tear and battle to protect humanity.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/angel-tear-goddess-betrayed/]Kagura Games[/url]]
